extraction_notes: SI Figure S1 is the only SI source containing catalyst-performance data. Values were read approximately from the small plotted image, so rates and temperatures from this figure are marked with qualifier '~'. SI Tables S1-S3 are characterization/activation-energy/TPD/XPS data and were not extracted as performance entries, except Co contents from SI Table S1 were used as catalyst metal loadings. The mass-transfer calculation on SI pages 12-13 reports an observed nitrogen-consumption rate for a diffusion criterion, not an NH3 synthesis-rate entry, so it was not extracted.
